_comment: Withheld from automated authoring under plan 5.3. The family is savage, barbarian, barbaric, barbarous, uncivilized, primitive, preliterate - words applied to whole peoples and societies, carrying a history of being used to justify what was done to them. Grading how much contempt each carries IS the sensitive judgement. Manual queue, never auto-drafted. Third such family, after held-5.3-deaf and held-5.3-illegitimate.
_screen_note: Caught by reading the draw, not by the ad-hoc regex - the third miss in three ticks. That is what prompted tools/sensitive_screen.py, which now carries the term list this family taught it and does flag this family. The screen remains a smoke alarm: it also flagged wild/untamed on 'savage', where the gloss is 'wild and menacing' about animals, and three families on the word 'black' (black-and-blue, a black day). A flag is not a verdict.
